output.headline: Sponsor with two Healthcare Services precedents, one in the Midwest, and a 17.1x median multiple paid, above the comparable 75th percentile.
output.differentiator: Its 17.1x median multiple paid sits above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x. Peer lines were not provided, so no lead over other buyers is claimed. [T:record, V:comps]
output.why_them: Healthcare Services precedents, one Midwest; pays above comparable upper quartile

acquirer_overview.title: Large sponsor with a long, mostly closed record
points: Financial sponsor; Private Equity segment assets under management of $416.4 billion as of December 31, 2025 [P:1].
25 deals from 2015 to 2024; 22 closed (88%) and 23 of 25 (92%) were control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Home sub-sector is Health Insurance (6 deals); 16 of its 25 deals were outside provider services [B:buyer, K:by_sub_sector, T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Own-sub-sector and adjacent provider deals, but no open platform
points: Sector relevance is a modest factor: 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector, 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors [S:sector_rel, T:record].
Platform Build in 9 of 25 deals, against 23% of all deals in the file, is its distinct motive; it has no open platform in the sub-sector [M:platform_build, A:angles].
Geography is a slight factor against; only 2 of its deals were in the Midwest [S:geo_fit, T:record].

precedent_activity.title: Two Healthcare Services deals, one in the Midwest, at 10.0x and 14.6x
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, 10.0x EBITDA [D:MA-2021-0407].
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, Southwest, 14.6x EBITDA [D:MA-2021-0195].
Adjacent dental: Crest Oral Health, $558M Leveraged Buyout, 13.5x; North Smile Group, $222M Management Buyout, 13.5x, both 2021 [D:MA-2021-0164, D:MA-2021-0453].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and Blackstone has paid above it
points: Comparable range is 10.7x to 15.3x EBITDA, median 12.8x; the 75th percentile is defensible as the 16.8% margin beats the comps' 12.9% median [V:comps].
Blackstone's own median paid is 17.1x, above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x [T:record, V:comps].
Ability to pay: equity cheque $128M; maximum price $193M at the same exit, $216M at a platform exit of 15.0x [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites a platform exit, and no open platform exists [V:lbo, A:angles].

risk_flags.title: Regional fit
risk_flags.concern: Having bought in this or a neighbouring region is a slight factor against its likelihood [S:geo_fit].
risk_flags.mitigant: Peak Medical Management, a Midwest Healthcare Services deal, closed in 2021 [D:MA-2021-0407].
risk_flags.reality: Only 2 of its 25 deals were in the target's region [T:record].

risk_flags.title: Low likelihood on a crowded list
risk_flags.concern: Seventh on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 4.3% [R:rank].
risk_flags.mitigant: Two own-sub-sector precedents and 7 adjacent provider deals support the approach [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Most of its deals (16 of 25) were outside provider services [T:record].

conviction.rationale: Two deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the call, but there is no open platform in the sub-sector, which keeps it neutral rather than strong. [C:conviction]
